name: Vancouver Waldorf School

geo.address: 2725 St. Christophers Road, North Vancouver, BC V7K 2B6
geo.coord_source: BC Ministry school-location dataset 2025/2026 (DataBC geocode of the registered address); cross-checked against OSM Nominatim street match 2026-10-30

description: Independent Waldorf (Steiner) school in Lynn Valley, North Vancouver, founded about 55 years ago; serves infancy/early childhood through Grade 8. B.C. Group 1 independent school (partially funded, B.C.-certified teachers, inspected).

attributes.philosophy: Waldorf: developmental curriculum integrating academics with movement, music, handwork and the arts; play-based early childhood; class-teacher model. The school describes an 'experiential, age-appropriate approach' and a 'slower, more intentional pace of childhood'.

legal_status.label: Independent school, Group 1 (Independent School Act, B.C.)
legal_status.authority: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care — Independent Schools Branch

attributes.grades: Parent & Tot, daycare, preschool, Kindergarten–Grade 8 (school website); register shows enrolment K–Grade 9 in its latest file
attributes.curriculum: Waldorf curriculum delivered within B.C. Ministry program requirements (Group 1 condition).
attributes.qualifications_offered: None at secondary level (school ends at Grade 8); no Dogwood.

tuition.notes: Kindergarten full day to Grade 8 tuition $17,750 plus activity & supplies fee $500–$1,500 (total $18,250–$19,250). Half-day K $12,520. International/non-resident $25,250. Tuition Adjustment Program for families under $200,000 gross income (minimum payable $6,000).

attributes.additional_fees: Activity & supplies $500 (Gr 1–3), $1,050 (K, Gr 4–7), $1,500 (Gr 8); tuition-adjustment application fee $130 + $50.
attributes.admission: Visit/tour, application, intake interview; 2027-28 priority deadline 10 January 2027, decisions 1 February 2027; rolling thereafter.
attributes.transportation: Transportation fees mentioned in the tuition-adjustment policy; details not published on the page read.
